title: Genome-wide association study of plasma polyunsaturated fatty acids in the InCHIANTI Study
authors: Tanaka T, Shen J, Abecasis GR, Kisialiou A, Ordovas JM, Guralnik JM, et al.
population: Adults in the Chianti region of Tuscany, Italy (InCHIANTI); replication in 1,076 participants of the GOLDN study
funder: Supported in part by the R&D contract with MedStar Research Institute, the Intramural Research Program of the NIH, National Institute on Aging, National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute Grant U01 HL72524, Grants HL-54776 and DK075030, and contracts 53-K06-5-10 and 58-1950-9-001 from the US Department of Agriculture Research Service.
authorConflicts: The authors have declared that no competing interests exist.
result: rs174537 near FADS1 was associated with plasma arachidonic acid (P = 5.95 x 10^-46) and explained 18.6% of its additive variance. Arachidonic acid, % of plasma fatty acids: GG 8.72, TG 7.39, TT 6.35; linoleic acid 24.27, 25.24, 25.88. TT homozygotes had 9 mg/dL lower LDL cholesterol than GG (P = 0.011). Replicated in GOLDN.
